name: Greenwood settlement lanterns and night lighting
nextAction: Finish PR #821's exact-head focused, offline-build, Canvas/Pixi and performance checks; resolve failures before merging; after verified publication, let owner judge native game aesthetics and iterate without extra premerge approval chores.

context.originConversation: 5 November 2026 SIBDLP chat; conversation URL unavailable; owner supplied 3 in-game nighttime screenshots and explicitly requested independent game-designer audit before engineering.
context.decisionSummary: Owner rejects roof-mounted glowing rectangles and overlaid rectangular post glass, wants believable, attractive entrance and street lanterns; wants the refuge lit after dark, without houses/workshops appearing fully active all night. Independent audit identified additional risks from draft PR #803 and specified corrected artistic choices. Later owner authorization explicitly makes in-game postmerge live viewing the artistic acceptance; a standalone sprite/mockup approval round is not required.
context.locationAndLore: Millhaven Refuge, adjacent Millhaven cottages/workshops, streetlight posts and Orchard Hamlet in the first region; preserve existing service identities, path/door access and accepted other-region scenes.

decisions.conceptAcceptance: Original lamp defect and roles were explicitly approved for autonomous engineering improvement; final illustrated appearance intentionally remains subject to post-publication live review.
decisions.proceduralDesignAcceptance: Engineering candidate #821 follows the documented art direction. Final creative approval is explicitly reserved for the owner's post-release live gameplay review.
decisions.spriteProductionAuthorization: None in this design-only stage; do not generate/replace raster sprites.
pendingCorrections: Wait for exact-head engineering/performance checks and hosted publication before claiming release readiness; owner will judge aesthetics in the actual game, after which any further changes are iterative.
Keep streetlamp approved silhouette, per-region distinction, service site fixture coverage, closed workshop behavior, camera-scale alignment and no phantom overlay protected in future iterations.

traitsToPreserve: Previously owner-approved roadside-lantern silhouette, glass panes, metal rim, hook, weathered timber grain, original count and glow footprint.
One meaningful refuge entrance light visibly on at night, remaining dark cottage/windows and closed-workshop work areas, coherent door/facade orientation.
Night climate and local warm/cool contrast, Canvas/Pixi parity, no runtime state or save changes.
Distinct Roadside Lantern, Refuge Entrance, Cottage Entry, Workshop Exterior and genuine working-service fixtures; no pasted rectangles.

assetSpecificDependencies.role: Previously approved protected post identity and finished look; preserve rather than regenerate blindly
Procedural-to-sprite handoff and true appearance approval
Existing Greenwood land-use and service hierarchy

variantRequirements: other regions protected pending site-specific review

proceduralOwnersAndReasons.reason: Canonical physical fixture geometry and glass
Canvas scene light sources must match real visible fixtures
Pixi compositing parity and true glass anchors after zoom/occlusion

animationRequirements.status: No new animation clips or perpetual flicker proposed; existing daylight progression determines glow strength.
animationRequirements.pivotContract: Keep world entity anchor and visible fixture glass center consistent across Canvas/Pixi zoom; no world/saved offsets.

production.releaseEvidence: Implementation candidate on new current-main branch in PR #821, including in-game facade/post art, source/glass contracts, regression tests and PWA fingerprints. Until checks/merge/hosted delivery are verified, no release or device-verification claim.
